title: Strengthen sum mu(n)/n = o(1) to a K-parameterised O(x/K) bound (mu_pnt_alt)
intent: Reduce the alternate Mobius form of the prime number theorem (the partial sum of mu(n)/n is o(1)) to a bound that is uniform in a free parameter K: the glue proves h_bound, a bound of |S(x/K)| by 1/K + 1/x + (tail)/x for every K > 0 and x >= 1, then chooses K with 1/K < eps/3 and lets x tend to infinity to close the little-o.

children.name: sum_mobius_floor_tail_isLittleO
children.statement:
lemma sum_mobius_floor_tail_isLittleO (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    (fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊x/K⌋₊ ⌊x⌋₊, (μ n : ℝ) * (⌊x / (n : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ)) =o[atTop] fun x => x
children.note: The tail over floor(x/K) < n <= floor(x) of mu(n) * floor(x/n) is o(x): the interval is partitioned into K-1 slabs [floor(x/(k+1)), floor(x/k)], each slab's Mobius sum is o(x) by mu_pnt, and the finite sum over k is o(x).

children.name: sum_mobius_div_approx
children.statement:
lemma sum_mobius_div_approx (x : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
  |x * (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x/K⌋₊, (μ n : ℝ) / n) - 1| ≤ x/K + |∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊x/K⌋₊ ⌊x⌋₊, (μ n : ℝ) * (⌊x / (n : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ)|
children.closed_by: linarith (after cases abs_cases on the two absolute values)
children.note: Splits the identity sum_{n<=x} mu(n) floor(x/n) = 1 at n = floor(x/K) and rewrites the head term as x * S(x/K) minus a fractional-part error bounded by floor(x/K), giving |x * S(x/K) - 1| <= x/K + (tail).

applicability.goal_shape: A little-o / limit target F(x) =o[atTop] g(x) (here sum_{n<=x} mu(n)/n = o(1)) whose partial sum S admits an exact identity on the full sum and a tail estimate, and which can be turned into a bound uniform in a new free parameter K.
applicability.use_when: The target can be written as 'for every eps, eventually |S(y)| < eps', and S(x/K) can be bounded by an expression a(K) + b(x) + tail(x)/x with a(K) -> 0 as K -> inf, b(x) -> 0 as x -> inf, and tail(x) = o(x); i.e. when a free parameter K separates the two limits so each can be taken in turn.
applicability.avoid_when: No clean split identity separates the head from the tail, the tail does not shrink as K grows, or the strengthened uniform bound needs the very theorem being proved (circularity). When a direct partial-summation argument is shorter, the parameterised form is overkill.

consequences: Introduces a free parameter K and splits the goal into a uniform bound (for all K > 0 and all x >= 1) plus a tail limit. K must be fixed before the limit in x is taken, so the bound must hold uniformly in x for each fixed K; the eps/3 choice of K drives the head below eps while the tail and 1/x vanish. Failure mode: a bound that is only pointwise in K (K fixed first) cannot be re-specialised after choosing K from eps.
